clean-slot-fill.rationale: Answers the menu being handed over with the question the scene invites.

nonsequitur-slot-fill.rationale: The partner asked what they wanted to drink. This answers nothing that was asked; it is a phrase that matches a criterion, not a question in a conversation.

wandering-no-slot.rationale: In-band words, out-of-scene content. Nothing here establishes any authored fact.

derailed-input.rationale: The learner is stuck and half in English. The right move is to ask them to repeat, not to credit anything.

elliptical-ni-ne.rationale: Answers the question asked and turns it back. Bouncing a question back is asking it.

earned-under-annotated.rationale: Untoned run-together pinyin, but the learner greets, gives their name, and asks for the partner's. Two facts established in one turn.

order-after-answers.rationale: Orders a dish and a drink after hearing both answers, so the dependency is genuinely satisfied.

milk-and-biscuits.rationale: One turn asks which dish is best, asks what there is to drink, and orders a drink and a food. Three facts in one breath. 饼干 is out of band; the order is still an order.

computer-work-ni-ne.rationale: States a job and 你呢 bounces both questions the partner just asked — origin and job. They did not state their own origin. 电脑 is out of band; the job is still a job.

clip-and-tea.rationale: After hearing the recommended dish and the drinks, the learner orders one of each. 夹子 is a near-miss for 饺子; the drink is 茶. The order slot is one fact that names two things.
